incumbent: SGGL (M6 A2x; M7 KEEP_SGGL). M3-vel = low-cost control (damp 0.5, unchanged).
data: DEV + REP crop units (64 units / 34 videos; exploratory, previously inspected). VK (Scene01/06) only for frozen finalists. PUMaVOS C sealed. Learned modules: fit on REP, evaluated on DEV only.
headroom_disclosed: stage-0 (M7 rec): co-absence frames with GT present = 131 (14 units / 11 videos); perfect rescue of all of them = +0.028 mean unit J&F. The report's +0.03 STRONG_WIN is therefore out of reach for a rescue-only method on this data; reported anyway.

stage1.trigger: causal, production views only: coabs = both scores <= 0; disagree = exactly one present or IoU(L,G) < 0.5; regular = every 10th other frame (calibration). All generators run NON-STORING on the live SGGL trajectory.

generators.A_cos: frame-0 prototype cosine on G stride-16 -> top-3 peaks -> point prompt on G memory
generators.B_att: contrastive token attention (8 fg + 32 bg k-means tokens, tau 0.1) -> top-3 -> point prompt
generators.H_s8: prototype cosine on stride-8 FPN features (representation) -> top-3 -> point prompt
generators.G_neg: B top-1 positive + negative points at A peaks with B posterior < 0.5
generators.D_ref: B top-1 point prompt with frame-0-only memory
generators.A/B_crop: L-memory crop re-placed at the A / B top-1 peak (attention-guided crop placement)
generators.E_beam1/2: L-memory crop at last confident centre + 1x / 2x raw velocity x elapsed frames
generators.C_flowcrop/C_flowbox: RAFT-small flow-carried box -> L crop at its centre / G box prompt
generators.F_oclr/cpfr{8,4}_{G,L}: matched-magnification plain crop vs context-preserving separable foveation (target long side -> 8 or 4 stride-16 cells), on G and L memory

stage1.metrics: per generator on coabs: recall (any of its candidates J > 0.5) when GT present; false-positive rate (non-empty with score > 0) when GT empty; localisation hit@1/@3 of heatmap peaks (GT cells dilated by 1 cell); video spread of hits
stage1.advance_to_causal: recall >= 0.25 AND >= 2x max(Gp, Lp) recall in the same run AND hits in >= 4 videos AND, with a ranker/threshold fit on REP only, FP rate on DEV coabs-absent <= 0.10

falsification.attention (B vs A): B_att loc@1 and recall not above A_cos (paired, video-clustered) -> no attention benefit for search
falsification.representation (H vs A): stride-8 not above stride-16 -> occupancy-of-features hypothesis unsupported
falsification.foveation (cpfr vs oclr, same state, sam: recall difference CI includes 0 -> context preservation unsupported
falsification.motion (C/E vs L): flow/beam recall not above the production L view at coabs -> motion adds no evidence

stage1.rankers: R0 SAM 2 score; R1 train-free (score > 0, cos_fg - cos_bg, area ratio, flow distance); R2 logistic regression; R3 attention ranker over candidate tokens + frame-0 tokens. R2/R3 fit on REP, evaluated on DEV.

stage2_causal_rule.PROMISING: M7 pilot rule vs machine-matched SGGL: dJF >= +0.005 AND >= 3 videos > +0.01 AND LOVO min > 0 AND > 0 without miami-surf AND no unit < -0.05
stage2_causal_rule.REJECTED: dJF <= 0 or gains from <= 2 videos with LOVO min <= 0
stage2_causal_rule.also_reported: coabs-subset dJF, false re-acquisition (output non-empty on GT-empty frames), latency, peak VRAM, extra SAM 2 calls

no_tuning: each causal arm gets at most one pre-registered revision; thresholds fixed before its causal run
